notes.title: Global patch 1.1
notes.notes:
A global patch has been released that finalizes and improves gameplay.
We headed for[u] storytelling [/u]and not asphyxiation by searching for items.

-Now quest items and problem solving are even easier.
-Fixed bugs when the player did not reach cutscenes and checkpoints.
-Fixed death zones in Stalingrad.
-Fixed problem with the interface for different screen resolutions.
-Improved the game design of locations
- Improved menu design and graphics settings.
-Added new interior items in the location.
And much more...

notes.title: Release of the game and further development...
notes.notes:
The game has become available for purchase!
We plan to correct all possible errors, make a special menu and add more content.
This is our first game, our team consists of only two people and we would like to take into account the wishes of the players and future fans.

notes.title: Update the demo version and the game page!
notes.notes:
We've been working on the game for a long time, adding a lot of new mechanics and chips.
We have updated the demo version of the game to the final one.
